'''thehooky Destroy The What! Hunt The Who!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[thehooky]]
* '''Published:''' 10 May 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 HD thehooky DS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Location, Location, Location (V), The Emperor (V), Tarkin (V), Lando Calrissian (V), Stop Motion (V), Image Of The Dark Lord (V), The Emperor's Prize (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

It's a deck that you think you know what it is, then its not what you thought?!?

== Notes ==

* Headers say Locations (5) and Interrupts (5), but the list has 4 locations and 6 interrupts; total 60 either way.
* Original-era (V): Tarkin (V), Stop Motion (V) and Image Of The Dark Lord (V) (Virtual Set 4); Location, Location, Location (V) (Virtual Set 5); The Emperor (V), Lando Calrissian (V) (Dark) and The Emperor's Prize (V) (Virtual Set 6). The draft had read The Emperor (V) as a second Emperor Palpatine and dropped the (V) on Stop Motion and Image Of The Dark Lord. Ket Maliss is unmarked: the printed card.
* Posted 'Endore: Docking Bay' dested Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay); 'Kader The Black' Keder The Black; 'Saliacious Crumb' Salacious Crumb; 'Boba w/gun' Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'maul w/stick' Darth Maul With Lightsaber.
* Original-era printing corrected: Tarkin (V) (Virtual Set 4) -> Tarkin (V) (Virtual Set 3) (an earlier dest had linked the modern virtual card of the same name).

== Strategy ==

Please let me know what you think of the deck, thanks for looking.

well this deck is not ment for a hunt down deck. every body thinks it is and is ready for one. then you bring out the senate caching them off gard with that and with the boonta eve pod race they are totaly throwne off! i was thinking of some shipes to put in but not sure what would work?

I know there is alot of stuff out there to stop the podrace but i can still retrieve force and every now and then cach some one off gard with it. i dont have any space in the deck but nobody would expect that and they use alot of force and shipes to go space and then end up just sitting there?!.

The Endore Docking bay(i love it) i triy to get Palpatine +Ket Meliss +DJsaber +Janus Greejatus, force drane for 3.(with the senate it is easy to do)and they will come to you!! then you move away and drop a under cover spy! it is to costly for them to move away so they will have to save up for it.

The Spaceport Docking Bay is there just so you can get to there planet if they play with no docking bays to there planet! other then that you can loss it or use it.

Lando is really just ment to be put on Executor so the other player cant drop any Beefy landos down! and Expand The Empire should go on Executor:Holotheatre to really add more force for you to activate.

good combos would be Jabba+ boba w/gun+ 4-LOM w/gun= 3 battle destiny, 9 power, and some good shooting.

there are alot of things in the deck to up set the other player such as Vasige'OTE and to toss in alot of silling kinks such as Saliacious Crumb, Bane Malar, Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba.

What i triy and do is get a good Main stuck on Endor for a few turns then when he gets him off i go rite back there and start force draining again forceing him to go back! if he dose not come back then i force drain for a load! The Galactic Senate is a must with this deck, with out it you cant get the cards up you need to make it run smoothly. do a little docking bay hopeing and retriev force with Barquin D'an and the podrace. Use the spy's and IOTDL(v) to stop there force drains.

it may not be the best deck out there but it sure is fun to play with!! i have plade 4 games with it and i have won them all.

plade a force drain Hoth deck, got Luke stuck on Endor the whole game!! had all his speeders stuck in the race destiny! and came out about 13 more cards then him in about 30 minuts.

plade a blow away the death star deck. he hurt me alot in space with the drains but i reaked havic on the ground and came out ahead with about 7 force after the death star was blown away. about a 40 minute game.

plade a Senate deck and i rocked that game with The Emperor(v) and Kader The Black i got to use M'iiyoom Onith onec to make him lose Luke SJK, and han solo! i won that game buy 28 in about 35 minutes.

The last deck i plade was a lightsaber combat and i got Qui-Gon Jin stuck on Endor and i had to use the Spaceport Docking bay to go to Naboo, i only have a few good destinys and i got a couple of them up to win 2 combats and placed obi-won out of play with Darth Sidious but lost 3 combats and Vader. i won with 4 cards left and about 48 minutes
